reviews.text: I was curious about the product after hearing about it online. As soon as I tried it I loved the Color and the texture. Super smooth and not sticky . Biggest surprise for me was how long it lasted (colour and shine). Definitely will try more shades.
reviews.zh: 喺網上聽到呢個產品之後就好有興趣。一試就鍾意咗佢嘅顏色同質感。超滑又唔黐笠。最大驚喜係持久度（顏色同光澤都keep到）。一定會試多啲色號。

reviews.text: I love these! Fwee’s glosses are my ultimate favorite glosses. This product has everything I love about the glosses- the thickness, shine, color payoff, comfortably, and lip blurring but now with an added lasting tint! 05 Strawberry pop is a warm coral pink, leaving behind a faint pink hue.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意！fwee 嘅唇釉係我最鍾意嘅唇釉。呢個產品有齊我鍾意嘅唇釉嘅所有嘢——厚度、光澤、顯色度、舒適感、模糊唇紋效果，而家仲加埋持久嘅染色效果！05 Strawberry pop 係暖調珊瑚粉，用完會留低淡淡嘅粉紅調。

reviews.text: Buen set para hidratar con un pop de color. No son los más pigmentados pero se ven lindos y muy naturales en los labios. Me encantan los colores rojos, rosados y siento que estos dos están lindos. No son pegajosos ni muy pesados para los labios. El kit está divino.
reviews.zh: 一個幾好嘅保濕加添少少色彩嘅套裝。唔算最顯色，但望落好靚好自然。我好鍾意紅色、粉紅色，覺得呢兩支望落都好靚。唔黐笠，對唇嚟講亦唔算重。成套裝都幾靚。

reviews.text: It's really light weight and layerable really glossy too. Last longer if you don't eat or drink. It is really convenient to travel with as it's small but the applicator is small with that too which is not so comfortable to use when in the rush, makes it a little stressful. But overall another good product from fwee!
reviews.zh: 質地真係好輕，可以層疊擦，仲好有光澤。如果唔食嘢唔飲嘢，持久度仲好。細細支好方便帶去旅行，但跟住支掃頭都細返，用起上嚟趕時間嘅時候唔太舒服，有少少壓力。但整體嚟講，fwee 又一好產品！

reviews.text: Looks really pretty and I love how plump it makes my lips look. It’s not overly sticky and the color is cute and great for a bit of color that’s not too dramatic. I do feel though that it doesn’t last as long as I wish it did. If you plan on eating or drinking, you’ll probably need to reapply.
reviews.zh: 望落真係好靚，鍾意佢令到我塊唇望落好飽滿。唔算太黐笠，顏色好可愛，適合想要少少色彩但又唔會太誇張嘅場合。不過我覺得持久度無我想像中咁好。如果你打算食嘢或者飲嘢，可能要再補。

reviews.text: I love the shade 05 Strawberry pop, the formula is a nice combination of a lip tint and gloss. It leaves a bit of a stain and develops a glass like shine after a while. It can apply a bit unevenly, but it’s not visible unless you look a slightly too close. The mini in the tube however is quite useless: it’s a formula that needs mixing and will separate in a tube.
reviews.zh: 鍾意 05 Strawberry pop 呢個色號，配方係唇染同唇釉嘅好好結合。會留少少色，過一陣就會變成玻璃咁嘅光澤。擦嘅時候可能會有少少唔均勻，但要近距離先睇得出。不過支裝嘅迷你裝就好廢：呢個配方係需要搖勻嘅，喺支裝入面會分層。

reviews.text: These lips tints are just alright. The colors are really pretty and I love how glossy they are but the formula separates so easily. These tints instantly turn milky when they come into contact with any water or saliva so it creates a pretty bad yogurt effect the longer your wear it. Fwee’s regular gloss formula is so much better than this.
reviews.zh: 呢啲唇染只係一般。顏色真係好靚，光澤感我都好鍾意，但配方好易分層。一接觸到水或者口水即刻變成奶白色，keep 得越耐個「乳酪效果」就越明顯好難睇。fwee 正常版嘅唇釉配方比呢個好多。

reviews.text:
This is one of the best lip tints I’ve ever tried. When you first apply it, it gives a shiny, glassy look right away without waiting for a film to develop. The applicator is amazing—soft, fluffy, and the perfect size for both quick swipes and detailed edges. It picks up just the right amount of product too.
After applying, my lips feel smooth and comfortable, similar to using a rich nighttime lip treatment. The color payoff is strong, and even in the photo I uploaded, it doesn’t capture how pretty it looks in person. The tint also stays beautifully throughout the day, even while having snacks or sipping drinks, and my lips continue to feel hydrated.”
reviews.zh:
呢款係我用過最鍾意嘅唇釉之一。塗上去即刻有光澤同玻璃唇嘅效果，唔使等成膜。唇掃好好用——柔軟、鬆軟、大細啱啱好，無論快速一抹定係仔細勾勒邊緣都得。沾取嘅產品量亦剛剛好。
塗完之後，嘴唇感覺順滑舒服，有啲似用豐潤嘅晚間唇部護理。顯色度好強，就算我上傳嘅相都拍唔到佢實際有幾靚。唇色全日都keep得好好，就算食小食或者飲嘢都冇問題，嘴唇仲持續保持保濕。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
